composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. creative_direction: Photograph several rose and pale-gold silk threads bending across the lower frame in broad overlapping arcs. Show individual fibers only near their closest crossing, letting the distant strands dissolve into a soft warm-gray blur. A low diffuse key light reveals satin sheen without hard glare. The composition should feel like a quiet landscape made from thread. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
